goal: Add --park to --release-claim (close the claim branch's open PR without deleting it, with a resume note, then the ordinary guarded release) and accept both Claude owner-label spellings for release, check-in and stop-author
prohibited_actions: do not delete any branch or ref when parking
do not weaken the exact-owner, mutex or tombstone-ordering guards
do not touch any migration or database object
assumptions: a first draft of this change was pushed as PR #4357 before this contract; the implementation is re-committed on top of main after publication so the declared scope precedes the reviewed commit
generation 2 supersedes generation 1 to add the queue-hygiene mutation-hook classification CI required for the new closePull hook
generation 3 adds the queue-hygiene wrapper refusal for closePull, required by its dirty-first test
stop_conditions: stop if parking would require deleting a branch
stop if a test fails for a reason unrelated to these files
